title: Check yourself: Ambiguous matches, hand-offs, what must not leak and the practice

blocks.text: Questions on what this page has just taught. Choose one answer for each.

questions.stem: Scenario S1, customer support resolution agent. A lookup by name returns three customers, and the caller has given no other detail. Which action fits best?

options.text: Pick the customer with the most recent order and proceed from there
options.says: Ruled out because choosing by a heuristic "is a guess that succeeds often enough to go unnoticed until it fails".

options.text: Ask for an identifier that tells them apart, such as the email on the account
options.says: The agent asks for something that tells the candidates apart and leaves the choice to the caller's answer.

options.text: Read the three candidates' cities back and let the caller choose
options.says: Ruled out because offering the candidates' values "gives data about three accounts to someone who has not been identified".

options.text: Escalate at once, since an ambiguous match is beyond the agent
options.says: Ruled out because "an ambiguous match is a reason to ask, and not by itself one of the three triggers".

questions.stem: Scenario S1, customer support resolution agent. A caller demands to speak to a human in the same message in which their name matches three records. What happens next?

options.text: Read the candidates' cities back and pass the case on with the caller's choice
options.says: Ruled out because offering the values "gives data about three accounts to someone who has not been identified".

options.text: Ask for an identifier first, then pass the case on once one account is confirmed
options.says: Ruled out because that sentence continues "(not even an ambiguous match)".

options.text: Choose the most active account by a rule, then pass the case on with it
options.says: Ruled out because choosing by a rule "is a guess that succeeds often enough to go unnoticed until it fails".

options.text: Pass the case to a person at once, before settling which account is meant
options.says: The page puts "an explicit request for a person first, because nothing may delay it".
